build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that funnels a ball onto a target floor pad using angled bars
create_ball_dynamics: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale and starting position on a bar
configure_funnel_geometry: configure left and right angled bars to form a funnel with a gap for the ball
set_spatial_relationships: set the task goal as the ball touching the target using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
review_task_parameters: review the task template parameters including ball_scale, ball_x, angle, and target_side
